fingerprint.structure: 6 slides: hook (problem + promise headline over the mascot) → anatomy diagram (3 forearm muscles color-coded) → 3 muscle slides (#1 to #3), each one explainer paragraph + 2 exercise illustrations → CTA (eBook)
fingerprint.hook: Problem-then-promise: 'YOUR FOREARMS LOOK SMALL / HERE'S HOW TO LOOK MASSIVE IN A T-SHIRT'; mascot in a fists-up stance
fingerprint.camera_motion: 2d-characters (mascot) on designed cards; illustrations only, no photos; 4:5 slides
fingerprint.pacing: 6 slides, 0 to 26 words of body text; one idea and one pair of illustrations per slide
fingerprint.text_overlay: Headings: Anton-like condensed heavy grotesque, Title Case (ALL CAPS on covers), navy #041732 with accent blue; '#N' numerals in blue, slightly italic; short blue underline (about 12.6% wide) under each heading; body: Didact Gothic-like light sans, gray #4b4945, about 2.7% of frame height, left-aligned at x=10%, 2 to 4 short lines; BLUE BRO logo top-left on every slide
fingerprint.audio: third-party sound (library-style title and author), not original, no voiceover; slideshow so the sound is only background
fingerprint.arc: Diagnose a body-part problem → name the muscles → pick exercises per muscle → sell the full program
